title: Emoji Blast

summary.en: An emoji-only arcade shooter for two, side by side over WebRTC — shared lives, a tether between the ships, no server in the game loop.
summary.jp: 絵文字だけの 2 人協力シューティング。残機は共有、2 機の間には糸。WebRTC で端末が直結し、ゲーム中はサーバーを通らない。

mine: Designed an emoji-only two-player co-op arcade shooter
Built peer-to-peer WebRTC play with shared lives and a tether between ships, with no server in the game loop
Built it as a single-file HTML5 Canvas game

challenge.en: Couch co-op on the web usually means one player gets the keyboard. We wanted equal agencies on two phones with almost no lobby friction — and a loop short enough to restart laughing.
challenge.jp: Web のカウチ共闘は、キーボードを一人が独占しがち。ロビーの摩擦をほぼなく、スマホ2台で対等に遊べ、笑ってすぐやり直せるループが欲しかった。

solution.en: WebRTC links two tilt/touch pads into one canvas arena of emoji projectiles. Pairing is the onboarding. The decisive move was equal inputs from minute zero — no host throne.
solution.jp: WebRTC で傾き／タッチのパッド2台を、絵文字弾の一つのキャンバスに結ぶ。ペアリングがオンボーディング。決定打は、最初から入力を対等にすること — ホストの玉座なし。

_notes: Renamed from EmojiDrop to Emoji Blast (2026-09-12, Takao).
